name: Concord
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Concord, NC 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Concord, NC: Speedway Christmas, Santa at Cabarrus Brewing, Snowland at Great Wolf Lodge, a downtown holiday trail and more.
lede: Concord celebrates Christmas downtown with a long running parade and tree lighting, then turns to big attractions, from a drive through light show at Charlotte Motor Speedway to Snowland at Great Wolf Lodge.
celebrates: The City of Concord opens the season with its annual tree lighting in Courthouse Plaza, with food trucks, a kids' zone, Santa and Mrs. Claus and fireworks, and follows it the next day with the Concord Christmas Parade down Union Street. After that, Charlotte Motor Speedway runs Speedway Christmas, a drive through light show on a four mile course, and Great Wolf Lodge fills its resort with Snowland activities and Santa visits. Downtown Concord adds a Small Business Saturday trail with trolleys and Santa, while Cabarrus Brewing and Cabarrus Festivals host a Christmas Festival with a kids play zone.
lastyear: The City of Concord counts its 2026 tree lighting as the 29th annual, which means the 2025 ceremony was the 28th, and it counts its 2026 parade as the 98th, so last year's was the 97th. The city says the parade is one of the oldest continuously running Christmas parades in North Carolina. Both events were free to the public, as they are this year, with children's activities and live music at the tree lighting and a route of more than two miles for the parade.
facts: The Concord Christmas Parade is the oldest Christmas parade in North Carolina, according to the Explore Cabarrus visitor bureau, and the 2026 edition is the 98th. The parade route runs more than two miles along Church Street, Buffalo Avenue and Union Street. Speedway Christmas at Charlotte Motor Speedway uses six million lights, according to the Cabarrus County CVB, along a four mile course that winds around the oval, pit road and infield road course.
trains: Concord has no train ride of its own on our list, but two are an easy drive. The Winterland Express runs through the lights at Village Park in neighboring Kannapolis, and the N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer runs THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride, which is on our Salisbury and Charlotte pages. Families can also see an interactive model train display at the Swanee Theatre in Kannapolis on December 11 to 13.
train_links: Train rides and, at Christmas, THE POLAR EXPRESS at the old Spencer Shops.
traditions: The oldest continuously running Christmas parade in North Carolina, held in downtown Concord.
A free evening in Courthouse Plaza with Santa and Mrs. Claus, a kids' zone and fireworks.
A drive through show of six million lights at Charlotte Motor Speedway.
Winter activities, crafts and Santa visits at the resort.
Trolley rides, local shops and a visit from Santa in downtown Concord.
kidfact: The Concord Christmas Parade is the oldest Christmas parade in North Carolina, and it has run for 98 years.
faq: What is the biggest Christmas event for kids in Concord?

Charlotte Motor Speedway's Speedway Christmas is the largest, with six million lights on a four mile drive through course, according to the Cabarrus County CVB. It runs from November 20 to January 3. The City of Concord's parade and tree lighting come earlier, in the days after Thanksgiving week.
Can kids meet Santa in Concord?

Yes. Santa appears at the Christmas Festival at Cabarrus Brewing on December 5 and 6, at the Small Business Saturday Holiday Trail on November 28, at the Christmas Extravaganza at Cabarrus Arena on November 27 to 29 and during Snowland at Great Wolf Lodge on select days.
Is there a Christmas parade in Concord?

Yes, the 98th Concord Christmas Parade was on November 21, 2026, in downtown Concord. It is one of the oldest in North Carolina. The next parade in the area is the Kannapolis Christmas Parade on December 12.
Are there free Christmas events in Concord?
Yes. The Christmas Festival at Cabarrus Brewing and the Small Business Saturday Holiday Trail are free, according to the Explore Cabarrus calendar. The city's tree lighting and parade were free too.
sources: Cabarrus County Celebrates the Holiday Season
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Concord for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (5th Annual Christmas Extravaganza at Cabarrus Arena) through January 3 (Speedway Christmas), with Small Business Saturday Holiday Trail (November 28), Christmas Festival at Cabarrus Brewing (December 5 and 6) and Snowland at Great Wolf Lodge along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Concord

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Concord
  • 2 free events: the Small Business Saturday Holiday Trail and the Christmas Festival at Cabarrus Brewing
  • Meet Santa: Cabarrus Brewing, the downtown holiday trail, Cabarrus Arena and Great Wolf Lodge, plus Brunch with Santa at Another Broken Egg Cafe
  • Lights and holiday fun: Speedway Christmas at Charlotte Motor Speedway and Snowland at Great Wolf Lodge
  • Season: November 27, 2026 to January 3, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Concord families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Charlotte, which covers Christmas Town U.S.A. in McAdenville, Winterfest at Carowinds, the Nutcracker at Belk Theater and Light the Knights at Truist Field.
